Futboll Klub Partizani Tirana is an Albanian professional football club based in Tirana, that competes in the Kategoria Superiore. Founded in 1946, the club was historically affiliated to the Albanian army and the communist regime. Partizani's home ground is the newly built stadium at Partizani Complex. The club also uses Arena Kombëtare for matches in European competitions and major domestic football derbies in Albania.
